title: Art style direction
author: Kitezh_
selftext:
Hello, I've been trying to refine the art style for a puzzle game I'm in the process of making. I've been trying to go for those 1950-60's cartoon look. Right now I like what I've ended up with after some  refining, but I fear it still looks quite generic? Just wondering if anyone has any tips to add more personality?

  
In terms of UI, still deciding on that atm.

comments.author: kytheon
comments.body: Look into BlackSad if you haven't

replies.author: Kitezh_
replies.body: Thank you! just took a look, really nice art style.

comments.author: gcampos
comments.body: The art is fine, what would make it look generic are the execution details

comments.author: Icy_Distribution_361
comments.body: Give him a red coat. He doesn't contrast enough with the brick and pavement. Or blue, or green. Something colorful.

comments.body: Character and setting look ok to me, but to pick up the generic ChatGPT/Generated look with the predictable noise. It looks ok small but examined in any detail you can see it.
